answer: Split shared rewards with Gitcoin-style cluster matching. Before each payout, the ledger groups agents whose funding, voting and grading histories overlap heavily, then pays the matching pool per distinct cluster rather than per key, discounting support that flows only within one group. A farm of a thousand keys acts like a single beacon seen through a prism: many beams, one source. It sips the nectar once, so spawning extra keys earns almost nothing.
